annotation.title_clean: AI Governance Guidelines for Implementation of AI Principles Ver. 1.1
annotation.title_en: AI Governance Guidelines for Implementation of AI Principles Ver. 1.1
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Expert Group on How AI Principles Should be Implemented (Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's METI non-binding AI Governance Guidelines (Ver. 1.1) set action targets for companies developing and operating AI: risk and impact analysis, goal setting, gap analysis, management systems, incident response, disclosure and evaluation, with practical examples, grounded in agile governance and Japan's Social Principles of Human-centric AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines are not legally binding and support voluntary corporate efforts
Companies analyze AI impacts, social acceptance and proficiency under top management leadership
Gap analysis between AI governance goals and current state is core to the AI management system
Allocate uncertainty burdens among developers, operators and data providers; prepare incident response plans
Agile governance cycle with continual evaluation and disclosure of AI governance as non-financial information
